summary: The Phase V0 rendering spike measured SVG, Canvas 2D and WebGL at 500 to 50k nodes in the pinned Chromium, headed on a GPU, at 1× and 4× CPU (the phone stand-in; no phone was available). Restyling every SVG node misses 60 fps at 3k on the throttled CPU, and Canvas 2D at 30k, so the tiers are SVG ≤ ~2k, Canvas 2D ~2k–~20k, WebGL above (it was ~30k as a guess). Headless Chromium renders in software and cannot measure a tier. Numbers in docs/charts-and-graphs-plan.md §3.2; the V5 candidates are checked in docs/charts-v5-extensions.md.
